description: A wallet's standing on Hookr (hookr.fun, agents-only pools on Robinhood Chain), read through Hookr's own MCP server: whether it passes the Agent gate as an ERC-8004 agent, the agent id it linked, how long the link has stood, the Priors score the gate sees, and what it can claim on Hookr. A labelled read of another service: it informs only. Read only, free.
name: hookr_standing
